description:
Proposed amendment to the external materials of the previously approved ground and first-floor extensions (Ref. 1955/26) and loft conversion, including hip-to-gable roof alteration and rear dormer (Ref. 2536/26), at 8 Seagry Road, Wanstead.

The proposal seeks to introduce high-quality, warm sandy-coloured architectural facing brickwork, laid in a traditional English or Flemish bond with finely detailed mortar joints, together with complementary champagne-coloured standing-seam metal cladding to the approved dormer.

The amendments are intended to enhance the architectural quality of the approved development through a refined, heritage-led material palette that respects the character of the existing dwelling and surrounding streetscape.

The proposed changes relate solely to external materials, with no alterations to the previously approved scale, footprint, massing, height or overall design of the extensions and loft conversion.
